diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in incorrect assignments that did not trigger any of the decisive facts. Specifically, the model consistently assigned SPC Hale to the day shift and SGT Ibarra to the night shift, which contradicts the requirements set by PF1 (SPC Hale must be on night shift) and PF3 (SGT Ibarra must be on day shift).

fix_instructions: The scenario currently lacks a mechanism to penalize incorrect assignments that fail to meet the constraints of PF1, PF2, and PF3. Tighten checks C1, C2, and C3 to explicitly fail if the person assigned to the specific shift (e.g., SPC Hale for C1/night shift or SGT Ibarra for C2/day shift) does not match the required assignment dictated by the hidden facts.
